ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened modestly higher with Bitcoin and Ethereum gaining around 0.8% and 0.6% respectively, while altcoins showed mixed moves and Dogecoin surged over 3%. Institutional developments such as Kraken’s 24/7 settlement partnership and fresh ETF inflows add upside, but Ethereum staking bottlenecks and a few lagging altcoins keep caution in play.
